decisions.decision: Store XRPL, Ethereum, L2 and total outstanding supply as separate point-in-time stock features; store issuer mint/burn and bridge transfers as separate flow features.
decisions.reason: A falling XRPL balance can coexist with stable or rising all-chain supply; chain allocation is not net redemption.

decisions.decision: Do not admit raw RLUSD Payment count as an adoption or prediction feature without dust filtering, issuer identification, look-alike token exclusion, unique-counterparty counts and concentration statistics.
decisions.reason: Bitquery found 99.6% of payment count in a 110-wallet dust cluster carrying only 7,722 RLUSD.

decisions.decision: Treat transfer volume as gross flow. Separately report issuer mint/redeem, exchange/custodian omnibus flows, self/round-trip transfers, and top-counterparty concentration.
decisions.reason: The observed $7.33B gross value included issuer operations and an $848M round-trip double count; it is not net external capital.

decisions.decision: Do not infer proportional XRP spot demand from RLUSD supply, XRPL stablecoin transfers, stablecoin collateral, or tokenized RWA headlines.
decisions.reason: RLUSD can transfer directly as an issued currency; XRP fee/reserve use is distinct from bridge purchases and observed fee expenditure is small.

decisions.decision: Keep provider-specific OI series quarantined until venue, contract type, quote currency, units, timestamp and aggregation method are normalized.
decisions.reason: Current providers differ by hundreds of millions of dollars and publish different coverage universes.

decisions.decision: Keep all observations out of model training until source provenance, point-in-time availability, historical continuity, source independence and leakage checks pass.
decisions.reason: Current observations are descriptive and do not establish predictive relationship or out-of-sample skill.

feature_requirements: RLUSD outstanding by chain and total supply, with exact issuer contract/account and ledger/block cutoff
Issuer mint and redemption amounts, net of same-window flows
Bridge and cross-chain issuance events with source/destination chain and transaction IDs
RLUSD transfer counts and value split by dust threshold, issuer, exchange/custodian, and other counterparties
Unique senders/receivers, median and percentile transfer sizes, top-10 share, HHI, and round-trip/self-transfer adjustment
XRPL XRP fees and reserve lock changes separately from XRP market purchases
Stablecoin stock, gross transfer flow, net capital flow and XRP spot volume as separate feature families
Derivatives OI by normalized venue and contract with timestamp and coverage metadata
